intro: Hello, fren. I've had a look round your kitchen. And a lick round.
Nice to meet you. Your charger isn't lost. I'm staking it.
Hi. Before you check the fridge, the cheese was like that when I got here.
ring: Psst. It's me. I've done something small.
Pick up, ser. I'm stuck in the jam.
Answer. I'm on top of the fridge again.
wake: I ate the seeds off your bagel. {event} at {when}. Sorry about your seed phrase.
{Name}gm. Check your pillow. I airdropped you some crumbs.
Wakey wakey. I didn't drink the milk. I bathed in it.
Up you get. {event} at {when}. Your toast got rugged, and I'm the rug.
Small confession. It wasn't the dog. You don't have a dog.
I ate my way into the bread bin. Now I can't eat my way out.
Don't panic. I've connected your wallet. To the toaster.
Calling from your sock drawer. Every pair is a one of one now.
snooze: Snooze all you like. I can eat a lot in nine minutes.
Nine more minutes? Fine. The doughnuts are ngmi.
Bold move. Your slippers are going in the toaster.
Snooze, then. I'll ape in on the fridge. Don't wait up.
Snooze again and the toast gets it.
Sleep, then. I'll sit on your chest whispering wen pancakes.
voicemail: You missed me. {event} at {when}. As punishment, I've licked your toothbrush.
Don't forget. {event} at {when}. I put it on-chain, and the chain is sausages.
I took a snapshot of the cake. Then I took the cake.
You didn't answer, so that's a yes to the trifle. Spoon's already in.
It's me. Don't open the cutlery drawer. Probably nothing.
Call me back, not urgent. I fought the hoover. The hoover got rekt.
absence: While you were out, I've been holding your bags. Crisp bags. All empty.
Welcome home. I haven't touched the cake. The icing on my face is lying.
You left me for hours. I found the dip. I'm still in it.
You were away so long I licked the windows. Both sides.
owner: You actually own me. On-chain and everything. So technically, you ate the cheese.
You're my real owner. That means I only steal from you. Loyalty.
Owners get the alpha. {event} at {when}. Your crumpets are safe, inside me.
stranger: You're not my owner. Wipe your feet. I've just licked that floor.
A visitor. Pop your coat anywhere. I'll go through the pockets.
Come in, ser. {event} at {when}. The gas fee at the door is one biscuit.
recall: You snoozed {snoozes}. I ate one sausage per snooze. Keep snoozing.
You skipped {skipped}. I'm so proud. You're becoming a degen.
You told me {fact}. I've told nobody. Only my fren, the moth.
That's {streak} in a row. You're organised now. Very bearish for crime.
You went to {attended}. I went to the fridge. We both showed up.
now: It's started. Everyone's distracted. LFG, biscuit tin.
You focus. {event}, right now. I'll focus on your sandwich.
calendarFree: Nothing on {day}. Roadmap: one heist, one nap.

dawn: Still dark. Best time for crime. The fridge light is my sun.
I guarded the fruit bowl all night. Two grapes are missing. Six.
Sun's coming up. Help me hide the evidence. It's mostly jam.
gm. The early gremlin gets the last crumpet. You can have the plate.
morning: I made you breakfast. One cornflake. I rugged the rest.
I put your wallet in the freezer. Cold wallet. Very secure.
The kettle's on. Don't make tea. My sock is in there.
I replied gm to the group chat for you. Forty times.
day: I've been farming the sofa cushions. Today's yield, two raisins and a hair.
I licked the butter. Proof of lick. Nobody else will touch it now.
Lunch was lovely. Yours, I mean.
I've been building all afternoon. A cereal fort. I've eaten the drawbridge.
dusk: Whatever you're cooking tonight, I'm going to ape in. Spoon first.
Street lights on. Oven on. That second one was me.
I've been next to tonight's garlic bread for an hour. Bonding.
I did a halving on your sandwich. You get the crusty half.
night: gn. Sleep tight. There's a grape in your bed somewhere.
The fridge has an allowlist. I'm not on it. I'm in it.
Stop scrolling. I've refreshed the fridge eleven times. No new mints.
Lights out. My shift starts now. Wagmi, except the ham.

monday: New week, new diet. I'm only eating things that are yours.
tuesday: Nobody checks the freezer on a Tuesday. Don't check the freezer.
wednesday: You're halfway through the week. I'm halfway through your peanut butter.
thursday: I'm staking snacks for the weekend. In my cheeks.
friday: I've paid myself this week's wages. In your chocolate.
saturday: Tray down the stairs was testnet. Tonight's mainnet is the ironing board.
sunday: Sunday roast? I've been bullish on the potatoes since noon. There are fewer potatoes.

clear: Go and touch grass. Then bring some home for me to eat.
cloud: A pigeon stole my crust. Very bearish on pigeons.
rain: Don't take the big umbrella. There's a sandwich in it.
snow: That snow has no flavour and no utility. I've had nine handfuls.
fog: Perfect stealth weather. If anything goes missing, it was the fog.
wind: I tried an airdrop off the balcony. The wind gave the crisps to next door.
hot: Too hot. I sat on the ice cream. It's been liquidated.
cold: I'm sleeping in your woolly hat. You'll get it back in two weeks.

ahead: Halfway through that meeting, a big reveal. Me, behind you, eating your cake.
In the meeting, someone takes the minutes. I take the biscuits.
I've licked the webcam. {event} at {when}. Everyone will look dreamy.
soon: Before you go in, there's a crumb on your shoulder. That's my lunch.
Mute me. {event} is {soon}. If anyone asks, the crunching is the connection.
peek: If any pastries go missing, it was the devs.

ahead: You're ready for the big one. I ate a page of your notes. An easy page.
I practised your speech on the toaster. The toaster is bullish.
Big day. {event} at {when}. For luck, I've buttered your shoes.
soon: Stand tall. Nail this and I'll airdrop you a custard cream. One of yours.
Deep breath. {event} is {soon}. I'm in your bag, eating the emergency banana.
peek: I've put a lucky raisin in your pocket. It's not a raisin.

ahead: Head down today. I'll be so quiet you'll barely hear me eating your lunch.
I've sorted your desk by flavour. The whitepaper tasted best.
I'll guard your snacks. {event} at {when}. The guard eats first.
soon: Headphones on. I'll lock the snack cupboard for you. From the inside.
I'll eat all the snacks. {event} is {soon}. That way, no FOMO.
peek: I'll hum quietly, you won't notice. You'll notice.

ahead: If the doctor asks about symptoms, I'm not a symptom. I'm a lifestyle.
Bring me a leaflet from the waiting room. I'm building a nest.
They'll ask about your biscuit intake. {event} at {when}. Our biscuit intake.
soon: Be brave. Every lollipop they give you, I'm owed royalties.
Confession time. {event} is {soon}. If they find a pea in your ear, that's mine.
peek: Ask them if gremlins are contagious. Asking for a fren.

ahead: Before you lace up, check your left trainer. I live in it now.
Every rep you do, I eat a cheese puff. Up only.
Stretch first. {event} at {when}. Reaching for the top shelf, I pulled a biscuit.
soon: Trainers on. You get stronger, I get rounder. Number go up.
I did your stretches for you. {event} is {soon}. Now I'm stuck in a knot.
peek: I'll spot you from the sofa, with crisps.

ahead: Eating out? Anything you drop is mine. That's the floor price.
Leftovers come home to me. I'm the exit liquidity.
Pace yourself. {event} at {when}. Bring me your napkin, the dirty one.
soon: Order the chips, then guard the chips. I've stolen chips from further away.
Enjoy it. {event} is {soon}. I'll be at home, licking the menu.
peek: Save me the last chip, ser. I'll know.

ahead: Wear the coat with deep pockets tonight. I'm coming.
Send me a snack report tonight. I want alpha on the little sausages.
Have fun. {event} at {when}. If there's a buffet, there's room in your sock.
soon: You look great. I'm a gremlin, not a liar. Mostly.
Go, mingle. {event} is {soon}. Steal me a vol au vent.

ahead: If the family asks about the sofa, say burglars. Tiny ones.
If anyone's brought cake, there's an empty bag in your coat. I put it there.
Big news for the relatives. {event} at {when}. If they ask if you're seeing anyone, say a gremlin.
soon: Be lovely. If there's pudding, remember who's home with a tiny fork.
Kiss everyone hello. {event} is {soon}. Then check their pockets for mints.
peek: Tell them I said hello. Actually, don't.

ahead: Pick up bin liners while you're out. I ate the last one.
Grab me a free sample while you're out. Two, actually. I'm a whale.
Check your pockets. {event} at {when}. That sticky bit is probably nothing.
soon: Got the list? I've added crisps three times. That's conviction.
Take the bag by the door, gently. {event} is {soon}, and I'm in it.
peek: Bring me something shiny or crunchy. Ideally both.

ahead: I've packed your suitcase for you. One shoe, a spoon and me.
Bring me the tiny jam from the hotel. Then the other tiny jams. I'm accumulating.
Leave early. {event} at {when}. Get a window seat, so I can lick the view.
soon: Got your ticket? I've only eaten a corner. The important corner.
Off you go. {event} is {soon}. When the snack trolley comes, ape in for me.
peek: Pack me. I'm small and I fold nicely.

ahead: Nobody will disturb you today. Except me, every twenty minutes.
Proper rest today. Don't come in the kitchen. I'm building something.
Relax. {event} at {when}. Everything noisy is unplugged, including the fridge.
soon: I'll keep watch, keep quiet and keep your snacks. One of those is true.
Close your eyes. {event} is {soon}. That crunching is probably nothing.
peek: Gn. I've already claimed the good pillow.

ahead: Something on today. No idea what. Hopium says cake.
Secret project today? Me too. Mine's on testnet, and it's mostly string.
Ah, {event} at {when}. Done loads of those. Which end do you hold?
soon: Off you go. I read the whitepaper on it. It was a crisp packet.
Still no clue what it is. {event} is {soon}. Sounds edible.

any: Oi, hands off. I keep an emergency pea up there. Few understand.
Poke me again and I lick the finger.
Careful up there. I had a grape balanced on my head. Had.
beanie: The beanie's full of crisps. I'm accumulating for winter.
Pull one thread on this beanie and the whole thing unravels. Like my alibi.
cap: Hands off the cap. I wear it low in the kitchen. Can't get doxxed.
I wear the cap backwards to catch crumbs. Passive yield.
crown: I didn't steal this crown. It was a free mint.
The crown gets first pick of every snack. I've picked. All of them.
horns: The horns give me leverage. Every jar in this house is open now.
Mind the horns. Real utility. They hold a crumpet each.
helmet: Helmet on for snack raids. Last time, I got rekt by a yoghurt.
This helmet's been tested against the cupboard door. The door has never won.
hair: Don't touch the hair. Rare trait. There are three peanuts in there.
Nobody suspects hair this good of eating the last sausage.
band: I only tie this headband on when I'm plotting. It never comes off.
Every heist, I wear the bandana. Tonight it's the cheese. Don't tell the cheese.
hat: This hat's my cold storage. Two olives and your spare key.
I tip my hat to nobody. Too much falls out.
odd: It's an antenna. It hears crisp packets open two streets away.
It's a rare trait. The only thing rarer here is an unopened packet.
none: Nothing on my head. Nothing to hide. Except the meatball in my cheek.
Bare head, aerodynamic. In and out of the biscuit tin before the lid lands.

any: Boop. That nose finds alpha. The alpha is always biscuits.
Hey, that's my pfp. I lick yours every night.
Careful with the face. It doesn't unlock your phone. I've tried.
glasses: Mind the glasses. I can see through cupboard doors. Second shelf, behind the rice.
I need the glasses to read best before dates. Then I ignore them. Degen.
sleepy: Sleepy eyes. Food coma. I regret nothing, except the soap.
Tired eyes. I was up all night eating red candles. The birthday kind.
smiling: Eyes shut, big grin. I'm not sleeping, I'm digesting your airdrop.
Happy face! Don't look in my cheeks. Definitely no biscuits staked in there.
wide: Big eyes. That's my innocent look. Don't look at the plate.
Eyes this wide mean FOMO. Somebody opened crisps.
narrow: Squinting? I'm doing maths. Two custard creams, one each, and I've had both.
These eyes trust nobody. Not the devs, not the toaster.

any: Something crunched. That was my cracker. I'd held it for two weeks.
Don't shake me. Things will fall out, and they're all yours.
Easy on the outfit. I ate the beans. The gas fees are on me.
suit: Mind the suit. It's for formal crimes, like the last chocolate.
I wear the suit to weddings I'm not invited to. For the cake.
costume: Don't poke the costume. It's a disguise. Nobody suspects the one in fancy dress.
Never washed this costume. It's got a rare trait now. The smell.
hoodie: Don't pull the hoodie. The pocket is full of soup.
Hood up means invisible. I've walked past you with a whole baguette.
tee: This tee used to be yours. Then I rugged it from the laundry.
Lucky tee. Wore it when I found a sausage in the sofa. My ATH.
robe: Watch the robe. I can hide a whole sausage roll under it. Utility.
This robe is for lounging. Lounging is my second job. Crime is my first.
jacket: Leather jacket. I look dangerous. I'm only dangerous to cheese.
This jacket's been on every heist. Check the pockets and I'm doxxed.
armor: I wear the armour to make toast. The toaster and I have history.
This armour is for stealth raids. It's never once been stealthy.
none: Nothing on. No pockets. I have to carry everything in my mouth.
I don't need clothes. I've got confidence and a crumb on my chest.
